provenance: Captured from the verified SimNIBS 4.6.0 runtime on 2026-09-10. URLs and hashes are recorded package metadata, not inferred checksums.

artifacts.name: simnibs
artifacts.provenance: Verified local release asset and GitHub asset digest

limitations: Conda packages are locked by exact URL and SHA-256; GitHub binary wheels by URL and SHA-256; VCS dependencies by commit.
PyPI dependencies are version-pinned. Source-build dependencies and compiler toolchain are not byte-locked. This does not promise bit-identical cross-machine results.
Existing result/cache manifests are immutable historical evidence. Different runtime paths or bytes produce different native runtime identities.
